Resolves #19118

Both `neo-agent-skills` pins move to the published 0.1.15, following the #19037 precedent:
- `package.json` and the lockfile move to 0.1.15;
- `pr-baseline.yml` moves to the reusable workflow at `fe1a9434163e`, the neomjs/neo-agent-skills#106 merge, whose six `SKILLS_VERSION` pins read 0.1.15.

This checkout now materializes release-notes §2's corpus recipe, which the 13.2 notes surveys (#19098–#19102) use to count their windows.

Evidence: L2 (a local install plus the materialized payload; CI's `baseline` jobs install 0.1.15 from the registry) → L2 required (dependency pins, no runtime AC). No residual.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — two pin moves and a regenerated lockfile, with no concept to teach.

| AC-2 | CI: this PR's `baseline / *` jobs run the reusable workflow at `fe1a9434163e` and install `neo-agent-skills@0.1.15`. |
